CFUTIL.Name: Critical Fail PF1e Utilities
CFUTIL.Settings.enableSurgeChanceHint: Master switch for Surge Chance. When off, no surge rolls, buttons, or auto-checks run (module can stay enabled).
CFUTIL.Settings.autoSurgeOnCastHint: Automatically roll Surge Chance when a qualifying spell or sphere magic ability is posted to chat.
CFUTIL.Settings.skipLifeAndHealingSurges: When enabled, Life sphere talents and Conjuration (healing) spells never trigger surge rolls.
CFUTIL.Surge.Label: Surge Chance
CFUTIL.Surge.ThresholdHint: Roll d100 equal to or higher than this DC to avoid a surge.
CFUTIL.Surge.NoSphereData: This actor has no Spheres of Power CL data.
CFUTIL.Surge.Disabled: Surge Chance is disabled in module settings.
CFUTIL.Surge.ItemDisabled: Surge Chance is disabled for this item.
CFUTIL.Surge.ActorDiceModeHint: How the surge chance d100 is rolled for this character.
CFUTIL.Surge.ItemDisable: Disable Surge Chance for this item
CFUTIL.Surge.ItemDisableHint: When checked, casting or using this spell/talent will not trigger an automatic surge roll.
CFUTIL.Surge.ActionDisableHint: When checked, using this action will not trigger a Surge Chance roll. Leave unchecked to surge by default.
CFUTIL.Surge.ActionDisabled: Surge Chance is disabled for this action.
